# Module documentation template

Copy and adapt this checklist for a new module. Keep detail proportionate to the feature; remove inapplicable sections rather than filling them with boilerplate.

```markdown
# Module name

Status: planned / prototype / production.
Last updated: YYYY-MM-DD.

## Purpose and users
User task, roles, and organization/branch scope.

## Pages and actions
| Page/route | User | Visible actions | Resulting state/navigation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Workflow and rules
Entry conditions, main journey, transitions, validation, and important exceptions.

## Data and services
Owned/shared records, IDs, service contracts, pricing/version rules, persistence.

## Access
Visibility, restricted actions, and prototype vs backend enforcement.

## Mock and production boundaries
What is simulated; sample resets; external actions; provider dependencies.

## UI states
Loading, empty, invalid, error, denied, success, and recovery behavior.

## Evidence and decisions
Links to references, requirements, feedback, and material decision records.

## Verification
Acceptance scenarios, actual checks/results, usable commands, and unverified areas.

## Known limitations and next work
Outstanding decisions and client validation status.
```
